subject: Renewal QBR + expansion roadmap — proposed combined session and dates
messages:
From: Jamie Brooks <jamie@ellipsishealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey@ellipsishealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — can we compress and combine?

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Our execs want to fold the expansion roadmap (multi-product pilot, billing change, and infra runbook) into the renewal QBR so we can make a single decision next month.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood run a 60-min executive QBR + 90-min technical breakout back-to-back rather than two separate days?
- Our preferred windows are Aug 6 (10:00–12:30 PT) or Aug 7 (14:00–16:30 PT). We can do either but would prefer Aug 7 if you have procurement/contract folks available.

I attached a short doc with the expansion bullets and our desired acceptance criteria. Also cc'ing Lindsey (procurement) to help with timing and DocuSign readiness.

Appreciate a quick note with feasibility and any constraints on your side.

Thanks,
Jamie Brooks
Director, Cloud Integrations
Ellipsis Health

Attachment: Ellipsis_Expansion_Bullets.pdf (pdf)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Brooks <jamie@ellipsishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — can we compress and combine?

On Sun, Jul 20, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jamie Brooks <jamie@ellipsishealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Our execs want to fold the expansion roadmap...

Hi Jamie — really appreciate the context and the doc. Short answer: yes, we can do a concatenated session but a few operational constraints to call out so we meet both exec and technical goals. Proposal below.

Proposed format (we've run this before with customers and it lands well):
- 60-minute Exec QBR (business metrics, renewal terms, high-level roadmap alignment) — attendees: execs, account owner, sales lead
- 15-minute break / handoff
- 90-minute Technical Breakout (deep dive on multi-product pilot, runbook, integration checklist) — attendees: SRE/engineering + PMs + solutions engineer

We can do either Aug 6 10:00 PT or Aug 7 14:00 PT. Monica (ops) and Marissa (renewals) are cc'd to confirm availability and any procurement windows. If procurement needs DocuSign ready during the exec segment (preferred), we should reserve someone from Legal/Finance for the second half of the exec slot.

I can host the roadmap demo (30 mins) in the technical breakout; would love to hand off the mutual action plan to Marissa to cover next steps and procurement cadence.

If Aug 7 works, we'll send calendar invites and a short pre-read (QBR agenda + MUTUAL ACTION PLAN). If you prefer Aug 6, call that out and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jamie Brooks <jamie@ellipsishealth.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey@ellipsishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — can we compress and combine?

Connor — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of constraints from an ops/procurement perspective:

- We need final SOW read-ahead 48 hours before the exec QBR if procurement is expected to sign the week of the meeting. That means SOW draft in our hands by Aug 5 EOD for an Aug 7 slot.
- Recording policy: technical breakout will be recorded for engineering reference; confirm if Arch/Infra want recording disabled for any segment.
- Required Redwood attendees for the technical session: one Solutions Engineer (Marissa to assign), one Platform PM (I'll join if schedule allows), and Connor as AE owner.

I've attached a suggested QBR agenda and a mutual action plan template populated with items from Jamie's doc. I also added a procurement timeline row to the MAP with sign-off checkpoints.

Attachments:
- QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf (agenda with timeboxes)
- Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (MAP with procurement timeline)

My preference: Aug 7 14:00 PT — gives us time for a clean SOW handoff and for Lindsey's procurement team to review.

Monica Patel
Senior Ops Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Brooks <jamie@ellipsishealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey@ellipsishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — can we compress and combine?

Thanks everyone — locking in Aug 7, 2025, 14:00–16:30 PT for the combined session.

I've created a tentative calendar invite and included the two attachments Monica shared as pre-reads. Please confirm acceptance and whether Ellipsis wants the exec segment recorded. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event?eid=abc123

Next steps (action items):
- Marissa: finalize Solutions Engineer assignment and add join link to the invite (today).
- Monica: send SOW draft to Jamie and Lindsey by Aug 5 EOD (confirm).
- Jamie / Lindsey: confirm procurement review window and whether DocuSign should be staged during the exec wrap.
- Connor: prepare 30-minute roadmap demo deck and share pre-read by Aug 4.

Jamie — if that timeline works, we'll treat this as the primary decision meeting and track sign-off in the MAP. If anything changes, ping this thread and we'll triage.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Renewals Lead, Redwood Inference

Invitation: Combined_QBR_Roadmap_Aug7.ics (calendar invite stub)
